method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (fhog-core.l4, with four regulative rules: s 12(1)-(2) residence, s 14(3) further information, s 41(2)-(2A) notify and repay for each trigger, s 41(3)(b)-(c) and (6) after the Commissioner's notice) and a seat layer (fhog-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a commencement date before 1 January 2010, a Part 5 replacement contract, or a third co-applicant answers an explicit not-covered value, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: First Home Owner Grant Act 2000 (NT), reprint REPF039 as in force at 1 July 2026 (last amended by the Treasury Legislation Amendment Act 2026, No. 18 of 2026), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/First-Home-Owner-Grant-Act-2000-NT-current-reprint-REPF039.txt; with the First Home Owner Grant Regulations 2000 (NT), reprint REPF039R1 as in force at 1 July 2009, as deposited at ../../../first-home-owner-grant-regulations-2000/registers/source-bundle/First-Home-Owner-Grant-Regulations-2000-NT-current-reprint-REPF039R1.txt (rr 3 and 4 encoded; rr 5 and 6 spent); and the Taxation Administration Act 2007 (NT) s 35 premium rate (8%), the market interest rate being an input

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run fhog-core.l4 ; l4 run fhog-seat.l4 ; l4 run fhog-cases-applicant.l4
checks.result: 174 assertions written, 174 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24, after the fix pass); 6 #TRACEs with an expect line (5 breaches by the applicant, 1 obligation pending), each read and as expected; a control copy with two expected values altered reported 2 failures, and a fix-pass control expecting the old not-covered answer for a s 13AA(1)(a) contract reported 1 failure
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the first home buyer applying for the grant, with their spouse or de facto partner: ss 3 (threshold amount and definitions used), 4, 4A, 5 with regs r 3 (non-conforming interests on farming or relatives' land), 6; s 7; the criteria ss 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 12A; s 13(1), (2), (5)-(9) including s 13(7); s 13AA as dated rules (pre-2015 thresholds); s 14(3) (regulative), (5), (6); s 15 with regs r 4; s 17(2), (2A), (3) as conditional answers; s 18 as a dated table with the s 18(4), (6) urban area; s 21; s 41(1)-(3), (5)-(7), (11), (12) with regulative rules for (2) and (3). Not covered (explicit answer): commencement before 1 January 2010 (s 53), Part 5 replacement contracts (ss 54-56) unless s 13AA(1)(a) already rules the contract out, a third co-applicant. Out: regs rr 5-6 (spent), s 16, ss 19-20, 22-23 beyond the s 41 triggers, administration, s 42 offence detail, ss 43A-50, s 45A valuation. The duty concessions that turn on the grant (Stamp Duty Act ss 89AA(2)(k), 89A(1)(ga), 90(1)(fa), 89AAC, 90A, 90AB; s 90D, the house-and-land exemption, does not turn on the grant and borrows only this Act's home and permanent resident through ss 90C(3), 88(1)) and the objection path for a grant decision (Taxation Administration Act ss 109-110, 115(2), 116: 60 days to object, then NTCAT only) are encoded in ../../../stamp-duty-act-1978/encodings/baseline-2026-10/ and linked in NOTES.md; cross-folder IMPORT is not possible. The NT levies no land tax.
